name: GTI Factura
author: GTI S.A

sections.description:
GTI Factura GTI Factura is a system that allows sending electronic invoices to the tax system of the Ministry of Finance to be registered as required by the regulations in the current resolution. The service is designed so merchants using the WooCommerce plugin can connect with GTI and issue electronic invoices.

Features:

  • Supports different payment methods..
  • Adapts to any WordPress them.
  • Invisible to the user.
  • Multiuser.
  • Allows issuing exempt invoices.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

It can be installed automatically from the WordPress plugins page.

Alternative installation

It can be installed manually by requesting the plugin files directly from GTI.
sections.faq:
Are there any requirements to use the plugin?

Yes, you must be a GTI factura electrónica customer and configure the site correctly for it to work.

Is there any usage documentation?

Yes, you can access the documentation through this link.

What causes the error? An error occurred while generating your electronic invoice; please contact the site administrator.

Generally, this is due to incorrect plugin credentials configuration, or incorrect configuration of product attributes or taxes.

What should I do if the electronic invoice was not sent to the recipient?

  • 1- Verify that the entered email address is correct.
  • 2- Verify that all configurations follow the standard.
  • 3- Contact integraciones@gticr.com.

Is there a testing environment?

Yes, to request it send an email to integraciones@gticr.com.
